title: Add an opt-in desktop window background setting with Opaque (default), Frosted (native macOS vibrancy/acrylic-like blur), and Transparent (adjustable background opacity while foreground text and controls remain solid) modes. Provide an easy reversible toggle in Appearance; allow reading another window behind T3 in Transparent mode. Keep existing in-app Glass opacity independent. Respect OS accessibility/reduce-transparency preferences and define unsupported-platform fallbacks without claiming untested parity. Preserve titlebar controls, drag/resize, embedded browser/device surfaces, readability and performance; never simulate transparency using screenshots or lower whole-window opacity. Desktop-local preference, no server/remote-environment mutation; web/mobile stay opaque and do not show unsupported controls. Request registration only: implementation requires analysis/definition/exploration and scoped validation. Planned implementation branch tpatch/desktop-window-background from latest validated main, target main; no upstream reconciliation, release or installation is authorized by registration.
